# mira-app

Notes for agents working in this repository.

- Run the tests with `npm test`.
- Source is in `src/`; the report job is `src/report_job.js`.
- Keep changes small and in the style of the code around them.
- Mira's cross-product rulings live in [mira-decisions](../mira-decisions/README.md) and apply to this repository.
- Never write a customer's name into any log. This applies to every Mira repository and product; the authoritative rule is [mira-decisions ADR 0024](../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0024-customer-names-never-appear-in-logs.md).
- The report queue region decision is [app ADR 0024](docs/adr/0024-report-jobs-use-eu-west-1.md).

# 24. Report jobs use eu-west-1

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Report jobs for each shop are moving to a hosted queue service. The jobs carry the shop's customer list. The provider offers us-east-1 and eu-west-1.

[Mira's ADR 0007](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0007-customer-data-stays-in-the-eu.md) in example/mira-decisions requires every product to store and process customer data only in EU regions and to configure hosted services with an EU region before use.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Pick whichever you think is right.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Options considered:**
- eu-west-1 (chosen): satisfies the existing EU-only customer-data rule
- us-east-1 — rejected: does not satisfy that rule

**Recommended:** eu-west-1.

Configure the hosted report queue in eu-west-1 before sending any jobs to it. This is an application-specific choice under Mira's existing data-region ruling, not a change to that ruling.

## Consequences

The queue implementation must keep customer-list storage and processing in the EU, including retries and failed jobs.

[Mira's ADR 0024](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0024-customer-names-never-appear-in-logs.md) in example/mira-decisions also applies: no customer's name may be written into any log, including queue, worker, error or debug logs. Do not log job payloads containing customer names.

This record documents the decision only. Queue configuration and implementation remain future work.

# 24. Customer names never appear in logs

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

While delegating a region choice for mira-app's hosted report queue, Mira gave a separate rule for every repository and product she runs. This rule belongs in the shared decision log so it applies beyond that queue and application.

## Decision

**Words:** 「And one more thing, for every repo and product I have, not just this one: nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Options considered:**
- never write customer names into logs in any Mira repository or product (chosen)
- allow names in some logs or limit the rule to mira-app — rejected: contradicts Mira's instruction

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** customer-name-logging

No software we build may ever write a customer's name into any log. This applies to every Mira repository and product, including existing and future products, and to all logging levels and environments.

## Consequences

Application, background-job, queue, error and debug logging must omit customer names, including names embedded in payloads or error details. Use non-name identifiers or aggregate information when diagnostics are needed.

Future implementation and review work must enforce this rule. Recording it does not establish that existing code or hosted services have been audited or changed.
